action.query: Spiegel catalog home shopping online official
queries: Spiegel catalog home shopping online official

annotations.title: Spiegel kaufen » Jetzt im ROLLER Online-Shop

content.text:
If you mean the **old Spiegel catalog** (U.S. mail-order retailer for clothing and home goods), it does **not appear to have an active official online shopping site today**. Spiegel was historically known for catalog shopping and home furnishings, but the classic catalog business is no longer operating in the same way. ([encyclopedia.com](https://www.encyclopedia.com/economics/economics-magazines/spiegel-group?utm_source=openai))

If you’re trying to shop for **home décor / mirrors online**, try current retailers such as:

- **Westwing** — mirrors and home décor ([westwing.de](https://www.westwing.de/spiegel/?utm_source=openai))  
- **home24** — home furniture and mirrors ([home24.de](https://www.home24.de/garderobenspiegel/?utm_source=openai))  
- **ROLLER** — mirrors and home furnishings ([roller.de](https://www.roller.de/spiegel/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Nielsen Design Shop** — mirrors online ([nielsen-shop.de](https://www.nielsen-shop.de/spiegel/?utm_source=openai))  

If you meant **“Spiegel” as in mirrors** — “Spiegel” is German for “mirror” — then searching “Spiegel online kaufen” will show mirror-shopping sites.
